Dear Sir,
NOTICEOFBOOKCLOSUREFORSUBDIVISIONOFSHARES
We refer to our communications bearing Reference no. LCI/ComSec/16/2025 dated May 12, 2025,
Reference no. LCI/ComSec/20/2025 dated May 30, 2025 and Reference no. LCI/ComSec/25/2025
dated June 20, 2025. Pursuant to the special resolutions passed at the Extraordinary General Meeting
of Lucky Core Industries Limited (the “Company") held on June 20, 2025, the members approved a
subdivision of the face value of shares of the Company from Rs. 10/- to Rs. 2/- per share.
The Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed on Saturday, July 19, 2025 to
determine entitlement for the subdivided shares. Members whose names appear in the Register of
Members as of July 18, 2025 will be entitled to receive the sub-divided shares of Rs.2/- each.
Members holding shares in physical form are requested to surrender their original share
certificate(s), along with duly verified transfer deed(s) (if any) and a legible certified copy of their
CNIC, to the Company's Share Registrar, M/s. FAMCO Share Registration Services (Private)
Limited, located at 8-F, Nursery, Block-6, P.E.C.H.S., Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi, after Saturday,
July 19, 2025, for exchange of new share certificate(s).
The copies of advertisement to be published in this regard in Business Recorder (English) and
Roznama Dunya (Urdu) on Monday, June 30, 2025 are enclosed herewith.
We would appreciate your assistance in communicating this information to TRE certificate holders
of the exchange accordingly.
Sihcerely
Laila Bhatia Bawany
Company Secretary
Encl: as above.
CC: Director / HOD, Supervision Division, SECP, NIC Building, 63 Jinnah Avenue, Blue Area,
Islamabad.
YBG
